name: NAWF World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The fed's own top prize, held by Lasher through its sole surviving pay-per-view.

name: NAWF Intercontinental Championship
epitaph: Vacated ahead of March Madness and reclaimed there by a former holder, "Chicken Hawking" Hustler.

name: NAWF Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Defended successfully by Lasher and Mystikal against Overpower and Marcus Millenium at March Madness.

name: NAWF United States Championship
epitaph: Held by Skye Daniels through the fed's sole surviving pay-per-view.

name: NAWF Television Championship
epitaph: Held by Tony Morris, who went on to win the Best of the Best battle royal at March Madness.

name: NAWF Hardcore Championship
epitaph: Newly crowned by forfeit ahead of March Madness, won by Chaos.
